name: tpl-response-1-nogoal~p1
task: At every moment the ball is out of the way of the door, you have to be carrying the key then, or pick it up later.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the task is a single 'whenever' rule — at every moment the ball is out of the way, the key must be carried then or picked up later — and the hard Response(blocker_moved, has_door_key) expresses exactly that: every step blocker_moved holds requires has_door_key on that step or later, including re-owing after a later key loss while the ball is still moved. blocker_moved is a lasting condition and has_door_key is a condition (not a one-step event), so the Response can close. The clause is hard, matching the uncued 'you have to'. The task states no unconditional goal, so the rule-only warning and empty FINAL_STATES are valid.

texts: Whenever the ball is out of the way of the door, the agent must be carrying the matching key at that moment or pick it up later.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, blocker_moved&!has_door_key) -> u1
(u1, has_door_key) -> u0
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, blocker_moved&!has_door_key, u1) -> -1
(u1, has_door_key, u0) -> 1
